title: Understanding Log Transformation
text: A log transformation is often used to linearize data that shows exponential growth. This means that if you take the log of the x-values, the relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ becomes linear. Look for a plot where the x-values increase exponentially.

title: Identifying Exponential Growth
text: Which plot shows a pattern where the x-values increase exponentially?

title: Characteristics of Exponential Growth
text: In exponential growth, as $$x$$ increases, $$y$$ increases at an increasing rate. This often results in a curve that starts off slowly and then rises sharply.
